speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will be asking your caregiver about your symptoms and history to help me understand what is wrong. Can you tell me how long the baby has been experiencing these issues and what specific signs you have noticed?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history; it is concerning that the mother had no prenatal care and immunizations are unavailable. Given these risk factors, do you have observed symptoms like yellowing of the skin or eyes, poor feeding, or excessive sleepiness?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur, bluish macules (petechiae), cloudy lenses (cataracts), and hearing loss in a newborn with no prenatal care or immunizations is classic for Congenital Rubella Syndrome.
